$comment: Player shorthand for the Guides search (src/lib/wiki/search-wiki-articles.ts). Reviewed list: only shorthand that is unambiguous in FO76 community usage. A query (or a whole-word run of words inside a query) equal to one of `terms` also searches for each `expandsTo` value; the literal query is always searched as well (expansion adds alternatives, never replaces). Terms and targets are compared after the search normalisation (lower case, apostrophes and dots dropped, other punctuation as spaces, so '25% LVC' = '25 lvc' and 'Overeater's' = 'overeaters'). Cross-checked against the tracker's shorthand map in src/lib/filter-utils.ts and the effect/perk names in src/lib/links/entity-link-index.json. Skipped as ambiguous: 'ss' alone (Secret Service or Super Sledge), 'cs' alone, 'ce' alone, 'ac' (Atlantic City or armor), 'gb' (Gold Bullion or Great Bend), 'b' and 'q' (single letters), 'tse' (a combination, Two Shot + Explosive, would OR into every Explosive guide), '15c' (obsolete name, not Lucky Hit).
